headword: {聞|き}き{取|と}り{調査|ちょうさ}

definitions.gloss: interview survey; hearing investigation; oral inquiry
definitions.explanation: A survey or investigation conducted by directly interviewing people. Used in government, academic research, journalism, and workplace contexts to gather firsthand information.

examples.japanese: {住民|じゅうみん}への{聞|き}き{取|と}り{調査|ちょうさ}を{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: An interview survey of the residents was conducted.

examples.japanese: {被害者|ひがいしゃ}への{聞|き}き{取|と}り{調査|ちょうさ}は{慎重|しんちょう}に{進|すす}められた。
examples.english: The interviews with the victims were carried out carefully.

examples.japanese: {聞|き}き{取|と}り{調査|ちょうさ}の{結果|けっか}をまとめて{報告書|ほうこくしょ}を{作成|さくせい}した。
examples.english: I compiled the results of the interview survey and wrote a report.

notes:
Compound of {聞|き}き{取|と}り (listening; hearing) + {調査|ちょうさ} (investigation; survey). A standard method of data collection where an interviewer asks questions face-to-face or by phone and records the responses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {聞|き}き{取|と}り{調査|ちょうさ}を{行|おこな}う: to conduct an interview survey
- {聞|き}き{取|と}り{調査|ちょうさ}の{結果|けっか}: results of the hearing
- {聞|き}き{取|と}り{調査|ちょうさ}{報告書|ほうこくしょ}: interview survey report
- {現地|げんち}{聞|き}き{取|と}り{調査|ちょうさ}: on-site interview survey

SIMILAR WORDS:
- アンケート{調査|ちょうさ}: questionnaire survey — written form, not oral
- ヒアリング: hearing (loanword) — increasingly used in business and government as a synonym
- {面接|めんせつ}{調査|ちょうさ}: interview survey (formal) — similar meaning with more formal nuance
- {取材|しゅざい}: news gathering; coverage — specifically journalistic interviews
